oneLiner: Transform rough status bullets into polished updates tailored for executives and team members.
problem: Busy professionals waste time reformatting and rewriting status updates for different audiences, leading to inconsistency and reduced communication efficiency.
targetUser: Product managers, project leads, and team leads who need to share concise status reports to both executives and their own teams.
coreFlow: User pastes or types raw status bullets
User selects target audience (executive or team)
User reviews, edits if needed, and exports or shares the update

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Welcome screen with quick start, recent updates, and help resources.

screens.name: Bullet Input
screens.purpose: Rich text area where users paste or type their raw status bullets.

screens.name: Audience Selector
screens.purpose: Toggle to choose between executive version and team version, with preview of tone differences.

screens.name: Generated Update Preview
screens.purpose: Displays the AI‑crafted update, allowing inline edits and formatting adjustments.

screens.name: Export & Share
screens.purpose: Options to copy to clipboard, download as PDF/MD, or send via email/slack integration.

outOfScope: Deep integrations with all third‑party PM tools
